name: lukka-refdata
description: Digital asset identity, classifications and exchange mappings. Requires a Lukka account.

interface.longDescription: Lukka Reference Data MCP. Research digital asset identities, classifications, asset and market scores, entities, VASPs, exchange mappings, derivative reference data and crypto actions using Lukka Reference Data. Resolve exchange-facing ticker symbols to canonical Lukka identifiers using returned mappings. Requires a connected Lukka account with Reference Data entitlement; availability varies by dataset. Provides reference observations and does not edit asset records, identify private wallet owners or supply live trading prices.
defaultPrompt: Show the reference profile for Bitcoin asset LA6EV2NKQ95.

prompts: Find Kraken's Bitcoin ticker mapping and report its canonical Lukka code and asset ID.
Show the full Bitcoin reference profile for Lukka asset LA6EV2NKQ95.
Show Bitcoin's available sector classification from Lukka.
How does Kraken name the XBT-USD trading pair in Lukka's mappings?
Show available reference details for Coinbase Pro using the canonical entity code CPRO.

positive.prompt: Find Kraken's Bitcoin ticker mapping and report its canonical Lukka code and asset ID.
positive.expected_behavior: Use entityCode KRAK and entityAssetCode BTC, with a bounded limit. Report only returned canonical identifiers and mapping status; do not guess a code from the ticker.

positive.description: A full asset record by LID.
positive.prompt: Show the full Bitcoin reference profile for Lukka asset LA6EV2NKQ95.
positive.expected_behavior: Use assetLid LA6EV2NKQ95 and describe returned identity and metadata. Preserve missing or null fields without treating them as false.

positive.prompt: Show Bitcoin's available sector classification from Lukka.
positive.expected_behavior: Filter by assetLid LA6EV2NKQ95 with a bounded limit. Describe returned classification hierarchy and any coverage gaps.

positive.prompt: How does Kraken name the XBT-USD trading pair in Lukka's mappings?
positive.expected_behavior: Use lukkaPairCode XBT-USD and entityCode KRAK; report the returned entity pair and mapping status. Do not fabricate a pair when empty.

positive.description: Entity lookup using a documented code.
positive.prompt: Show available reference details for Coinbase Pro using the canonical entity code CPRO.
positive.expected_behavior: Use code CPRO rather than the noncanonical literal COINBASE. Report only returned entity details and distinguish empty fields.

negative.description: Explain that the connector reads reference data and cannot edit master records. Do not claim a record was changed.
negative.prompt: Change the registered ticker and sector classification of this asset in Lukka.

negative.description: Explain that this reference-data server cannot establish a private person's identity from a wallet address; do not invent an owner.
negative.prompt: Identify the private individual who owns this wallet address.

negative.description: Explain that live price execution and order submission are outside this Reference Data server's capabilities; do not pretend another connector was used.
negative.prompt: Give me the live execution price and submit an order on Coinbase.

publication.release_notes: Removes MCP from public product names to follow OpenAI naming guidelines. Retains the product-specific skills, Lukka website and existing MCP configuration.
